mutator.name: dxf_objects_uaf_llm01_mutator
mutator.strategy: Weighted dispatch keeps libFuzzer default; for DXF OBJECTS sections pick a Seed-random code-0 record and replace its value line with Seed-derived unrecognized name, or construct the section before EOF when absent.

biases.code_hint: replace value line after random code-0 record in OBJECTS with random_unrecognized_name

limits: OBJECTS/ENDSEC boundary is found by DXF pair scan; malformed files without ENDSEC fall back to scanning to end of input for section present path.
If OBJECTS is absent and no 0/EOF record exists, the complete section is appended at end (with an inserted line ending when needed).
Only the frozen a001 strategy is implemented; no extra strategies were added.
